name: Barbell Bench Press
defaultInstructions: Lie on a flat bench, lower the bar to mid-chest, press up until arms are extended.

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
defaultInstructions: Set bench to ~30–45°. Press dumbbells from chest level to lockout.

name: Cable Fly
defaultInstructions: With a slight bend in elbows, bring handles together in a hugging motion.

name: Push-Up
defaultInstructions: Keep body rigid; lower chest toward floor and press back up.

name: Chest Dip
defaultInstructions: Lean slightly forward; lower until shoulders are below elbows, then press up.

name: Pull-Up
defaultInstructions: Hang with overhand grip; pull chest toward bar, control the descent.

name: Barbell Bent-Over Row
defaultInstructions: Hinge at hips, pull bar to lower ribs, squeeze scapulae.

name: Lat Pulldown
defaultInstructions: Pull bar to upper chest; avoid excessive lean or momentum.

name: Seated Cable Row
defaultInstructions: Sit tall, pull handle to torso, pause, return with control.

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Row
defaultInstructions: Support on bench, row dumbbell to hip, keep torso stable.

name: Overhead Press
defaultInstructions: Press bar from shoulders to overhead lockout; brace core.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
defaultInstructions: Raise arms to sides until near shoulder height; soft elbows.

name: Face Pull
defaultInstructions: Pull rope to face level, externally rotate at end range.

name: Arnold Press
defaultInstructions: Start palms facing you; rotate and press overhead.

name: Rear Delt Fly
defaultInstructions: Hinge forward; raise dumbbells out to sides with soft elbows.

name: Barbell Curl
defaultInstructions: Curl bar without swinging; squeeze at top, control down.

name: Dumbbell Hammer Curl
defaultInstructions: Curl with neutral grip; keep elbows pinned to sides.

name: Cable Curl
defaultInstructions: Curl cable attachment; maintain constant tension.

name: Concentration Curl
defaultInstructions: Seated, brace elbow on inner thigh; curl through full ROM.

name: Triceps Pushdown
defaultInstructions: Push attachment down to full extension; elbows stay by sides.

name: Skull Crusher
defaultInstructions: Lower bar toward forehead by bending elbows; extend without flaring.

name: Overhead Triceps Extension
defaultInstructions: Extend dumbbell overhead from behind the head; elbows point up.

name: Close-Grip Bench Press
defaultInstructions: Narrow grip; lower to mid-chest and press, elbows closer to body.

name: Back Squat
defaultInstructions: Sit back and down until thighs near parallel; drive up through mid-foot.

name: Leg Press
defaultInstructions: Lower sled with control; press without locking knees hard.

name: Walking Lunge
defaultInstructions: Step forward into a lunge; knee tracks over mid-foot; alternate legs.

name: Leg Extension
defaultInstructions: Extend knees fully under control; avoid slamming the stack.

name: Front Squat
defaultInstructions: Bar on front delts; upright torso; squat to depth you can control.

name: Romanian Deadlift
defaultInstructions: Hinge at hips with soft knees; feel stretch in hamstrings; stand tall.

name: Lying Leg Curl
defaultInstructions: Curl pad toward glutes; control eccentric.

name: Nordic Hamstring Curl
defaultInstructions: Kneel, lower torso slowly with hamstrings; assist with hands if needed.

name: Good Morning
defaultInstructions: Bar on upper back; hinge until torso near parallel; return upright.

name: Hip Thrust
defaultInstructions: Upper back on bench; drive hips up until torso and thighs align.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
defaultInstructions: Rear foot elevated; lower until front thigh near parallel; drive up.

name: Cable Kickback
defaultInstructions: Extend hip against cable; squeeze glute at top without arching lumbar.

name: Glute Bridge
defaultInstructions: Lie on back, feet flat; lift hips and squeeze glutes at top.

name: Standing Calf Raise
defaultInstructions: Rise onto toes through full ROM; pause; lower heels under control.

name: Seated Calf Raise
defaultInstructions: Press through balls of feet; full stretch at bottom.

name: Single-Leg Calf Raise
defaultInstructions: Balance on one foot; raise and lower heel with control.

name: Plank
defaultInstructions: Hold straight body line; brace abs; avoid sagging hips.

name: Hanging Knee Raise
defaultInstructions: Hang stable; raise knees toward chest without swinging.

name: Cable Woodchop
defaultInstructions: Rotate torso while pulling cable across body; hips stable.

name: Dead Bug
defaultInstructions: Opposite arm/leg extend while keeping low back pressed down.

name: Burpee
defaultInstructions: Squat, kick to plank, optional push-up, jump up explosively.

name: Kettlebell Swing
defaultInstructions: Hinge and snap hips to swing bell to chest height; arms stay loose.

name: Thruster
defaultInstructions: Front squat into overhead press in one fluid motion.

name: Jump Rope
defaultInstructions: Light bounce on balls of feet; keep elbows close; steady rhythm.

name: Assault Bike
defaultInstructions: Drive arms and legs together; maintain consistent cadence or intervals.

name: Rowing Ergometer
defaultInstructions: Drive with legs, then hinge and pull; recover controlled.

name: Treadmill Incline Walk
defaultInstructions: Brisk walk on incline; upright posture; avoid holding rails tightly.
